impact.text: Every new veTRUST locker who does not interact with MultiVault during their first claimable epoch loses 70% of that epoch's rewards

precondition_sources.text: Alice locks 100,000 wrapped TRUST in epoch N as her first-ever lock.
Alice had no veTRUST before epoch N, so eligible[epoch N-1] = 0.
Alice never claimed, so userClaimedRewardsForEpoch[Alice][epoch N-1] = 0.
Alice never calls deposit or redeem on MultiVault, so her personalUtilization stays 0.

intent_sources.text: A user with nothing claimable last epoch (target == 0 and eligible[prev] == 0) must not be penalized on their first ever claim and should receive the intended 100% utilization ratio.
